name: seo-content
description: Turn Google Search Console data into content opportunities and review-ready blog drafts — quick wins, cannibalisation, decaying pages, optional competitor gaps — without a Semrush/Ahrefs subscription. Every user brings their own keys.

google_key_file.title: Google service-account key file
google_key_file.description: Absolute path to YOUR service-account JSON key (from your own Google Cloud project). The file stays on your machine; add its client_email as a user in Search Console (and GA4, optional).

dataforseo_login.title: DataForSEO API login (optional)
dataforseo_login.description: Your own DataForSEO API login — enables competitor gaps, search volume and SERP snapshots (pay-as-you-go). Leave empty to use Search Console only.

dataforseo_password.title: DataForSEO API password (optional)
dataforseo_password.description: Your own DataForSEO API password. Stored in your OS keychain.
